comment: The class is an easy A if you do the homework quizzes and do some basic studying for the tests. The grading procedures are very easy to understand. Hes a nice guy and hes really helpful if you talk to him at his office hours. The class is a ton of lecturing and can be pretty boring at times, but youre on your computer most of the time anyways.

He just stands there and reads powerpoints that are not helpful for exams. All of the exams are online so people easily use Quizlet. It's a really boring class but an easy A if you cheat on a test and homework. If you want to learn, read the book. The only good thing is that you only have 12 homework quizzes and those are extra credit.
